verdict.rationale: Yubico exposes programmatic surfaces, including the YubiEnterprise REST API and YubiCloud OTP Client IDs, so scoped API credentials are a fair question for this product. However, no evidence shows any ability to issue scoped or least-privilege API tokens for an agent. Hardware-stored keys (PIV, SSH, OATH) and the ykman CLI are adjacent building blocks, not a documented credential-scoping feature.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
